scientific_integrity: All general assertions are established by a geometric Artin–Schreier quotient and a genus/gap count. Finite exact-integer checks supplement, but do not certify, the infinite result. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime characteristic, algebraically closed base field, polynomial degree d>=2 coprime to p after subtracting one; only the smooth projective normalization and its unique point over infinity are studied. Earlier literature may contain a disguised equivalent theorem.
title: The Weierstrass semigroup of a non-Galois twisted Artin–Schreier cover
